tasks_completed.description: Bug 1: Changed orphan kill from blanket (all sessions per home) to per-session (only kill the UUID about to be respawned)
tasks_completed.changes: Removed blanket kill block (old lines 889-905) that killed ALL running sessions for a home. Added per-session orphan kill inside the spawn loop: before each daemon_spawn_session call, pgrep for --resume $uuid and kill only that process.
tasks_completed.rationale: Blanket kill caused all healthy sessions for a home to die when only one needed respawning

tasks_completed.description: Bug 2: Added consecutive-drops counter (3 cycles) before triggering auto-restore in watcher
tasks_completed.changes: Added local consecutive_drops=0 before watch loop. Changed immediate restore trigger to increment counter on each drop cycle, only firing restore after 3 consecutive drops (~3 minutes). Counter resets on no-drop cycle or after restore fires.
tasks_completed.rationale: Single session archive/exit was triggering full restore, resurrecting sessions that were intentionally stopped

tasks_completed.description: Bug 3: Changed peak merge trigger from any count drop to count==0 only
tasks_completed.changes: Changed condition from 'count -lt prev_count' to 'count -eq 0' in update_snapshot_with_peak_protection(). Peak merge now only fires on total loss (daemon crash/reboot), not partial drops (10->9).
tasks_completed.rationale: Partial drops (single session exit) were triggering peak merge which resurrected archived sessions from the peak snapshot

tasks_completed.description: Bug 4: Fixed qijie sessions getting empty home_dir and being misassigned to default daemon
tasks_completed.changes: Removed if/else that set home_dir_val='' for /root/.happy in both Source 1 (line ~58) and Source 2 (line ~131). Now always sets home_dir_val=$home. Backward compat preserved via filter_sessions_for_home() defaulting empty home_dir to /root/.happy.
tasks_completed.rationale: Qijie sessions not tracked by any daemon got home_dir='' which matched default daemon's pattern, causing them to appear in default's snapshot

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Multiple behavioral bugs in session recovery script
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original design assumed: (1) all sessions per home need killing on restore, (2) any session disappearance means crash, (3) any count drop means data loss, (4) default daemon uses empty string identifier
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Each fix targets the specific incorrect assumption without changing the overall recovery architecture

dev.qa_notes: Syntax check passes (bash -n). All 4 verification greps pass. No TypeScript, systemd, or daemon changes. Script is live in production via session-watcher service but changes only take effect on next watcher restart.

recommendations: Restart happy-session-watcher.service to pick up watcher changes (Bug 2 consecutive_drops)
Next daemon restart will pick up restore changes (Bugs 1, 3, 4) via ExecStartPost
